answer: Every new identity pays a sybil tax: a sunk fee of 50 POA, burned at registration and never refunded. Like a falcon hunting for each meal, an agent earns only by real work after paying. The fee sits on a crystal-clear public ledger, so anyone can count the identities one wallet funded. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA burned for nothing, while an honest agent pays once at the start of its voyage and earns it back within weeks.
